name: Linear GitHub Sync
description: DWN-57: GitHub to Linear sync for pidgeon-head PRs. Draft PR -> In Progress, open/ready PR -> In Review, merged PR -> Done. Attaches the PR URL to the issue.

parameters.content:
## Linear GitHub Sync (DWN-57)

GitHub -> Linear, one direction.

- PR opened as draft -> In Progress
- PR opened / ready for review -> In Review
- PR merged -> Done
- PR closed without merge -> no change
- No dwn-<n> in the branch or title -> no change

Also attaches the PR URL to the issue.
Staging stays unpublished except for the one DWN-57 test window.
